title: They Can See It but Not Say It: Iterative Self Knowledge Re-expression in Visual Reasoning Relative Pose Identification
summary: SKR-ID identifies stable VLM output biases in relative-pose reasoning and improves Macro-F1 across three open VLMs without annotations.
ai_technology: Self-knowledge re-expression and logit debiasing for vision-language models
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: §7 and Tables 2–3 report significant gains from 35.0–45.4% to 53.7–58.0% across 7-Scenes/ScanNet and ablations.
evidence.unknown: Three models, multiple scenes and three-run statistical tests support the bounded visual-reasoning result.
evidence.ai_role: §§5–6 use self-knowledge re-expression, logit debiasing and unannotated image pairs.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
